const [setupStat, fetchHead, status, head, remote, counts, log, trailers, ci, openPrds, openUnknowns, allPrds, allUnknowns] = await Promise.all([
  gm.stat_file({ path: 'tools/gm-continue-setup.mjs' }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: 'git fetch --quiet origin main' }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: 'git status --porcelain=v1 -uall' }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: 'git rev-parse HEAD' }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: 'git rev-parse origin/main' }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: 'git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main' }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: "git log -1 --format='%H %an %s'" }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: "git log -1 --format='%B' | git interpret-trailers --parse" }),
  gm.run_shell({ command: "gh run list --repo AnEntrypoint/cleetus --workflow publish.yml --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,headSha,status,conclusion --jq '.[] | select(.headSha==\"6c39a166eeaa8049833d7254748815d40a3acc81\") | [(.databaseId|tostring),.headSha,.status,(.conclusion // \"null\")] | @tsv'", timeoutMs: 60000 }),
  gm.prd_list({ status: 'open' }),
  gm.unknown_list({ status: 'open' }),
  gm.prd_list({ status: 'all' }),
  gm.unknown_list({ status: 'all' }),
]);
const expected = '6c39a166eeaa8049833d7254748815d40a3acc81';
const result = {
  expected,
  headMoved: head.output.trim() !== expected || remote.output.trim() !== expected,
  clean: status.output.trim() === '',
  headMatchesOrigin: head.output.trim() === remote.output.trim(),
  aheadBehind: counts.output.trim(),
  ci: ci.output.trim(),
  openRows: openPrds.output === '(none)' && openUnknowns.output === '(none)' ? 0 : 1,
  trailers: trailers.output.trim(),
};
console.log('Batch plan: ' + result.openRows + ' open row(s), planned before any work starts.');
return { result, setupStat, fetchHead, status, head, remote, counts, log, trailers, ci, openPrds, openUnknowns, allPrds, allUnknowns };
